name: LS-WebStudio Product Optimizer for WooCommerce
author: lswebstudio

sections.description:
LS-WebStudio Optimizer analyzes your real product catalog and order history entirely locally, on your own WordPress site, and turns what it finds into concrete, explainable suggestions for improving conversion rate:

  • Weak product titles
  • Thin or unpersuasive product descriptions
  • Missing product image alt text
  • Prices that look anomalous compared to your store’s own sales history

There is no external server, no account, no signup, and no license key. Everything the plugin analyzes, including your products and orders, stays on your site. Nothing is ever transmitted anywhere. It’s completely free.

Suggestion only, by design. LS-WebStudio Optimizer never changes your store automatically. Every suggestion appears on the LS-WebStudio Optimizer dashboard for you to review, along with the reasoning behind it and a side by side comparison of the current value and the proposed value. You decide what to apply, and every applied change is reversible with a single click on Undo.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce must be installed and active. LS-WebStudio Optimizer will show an admin notice and stay inactive if WooCommerce is not detected.
  • Nothing else. No signup, no API key, and no configuration. Analysis runs locally as soon as the plugin is active.

How it works

  1. LS-WebStudio Optimizer builds a snapshot of your product catalog and recent orders and analyzes it locally, right on your own server. The first analysis runs automatically as soon as you activate the plugin, and then once a week after that.
  2. Every matching product is considered, not just one example. If ten products are missing image alt text, all ten are eligible, not just the first one found.
  3. Suggestions are prioritized by each product’s own sales history, so an issue on a best selling product is proposed before the same issue on a product nobody buys. Up to ten new suggestions are added per run, so a large catalog is worked through gradually over several weeks rather than all at once.
  4. You review pending suggestions on the LS-WebStudio Optimizer dashboard (WooCommerce → LS-WebStudio Optimizer) and click Apply or Dismiss on each one.
  5. Applying a suggestion backs up the current value first, so you can always click Undo to restore it.

Credits

LS-WebStudio Optimizer is developed and maintained by LS-WebStudio. https://ls-webstudio.co.il/
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate LS-WebStudio Optimizer through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  4. Visit WooCommerce → LS-WebStudio Optimizer. Suggestions from the first analysis appear there right after activation, and the dashboard refreshes with a new batch once a week after that.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin change my product data automatically?

No. LS-WebStudio Optimizer only ever proposes changes. A change to a product’s title, description, or image alt text is made only when you click Apply on that specific suggestion, and it can be undone at any time.

What happens to price anomaly suggestions?

Price anomaly suggestions are informational only, by design. There is no single correct replacement price the plugin could safely infer, since regular price, sale price, tax class, and currency all factor in. No Apply button is shown for this type. It simply flags the product for you to review and price yourself.

Does this send my store data anywhere?

No. All analysis runs locally on your own server, using your own WordPress database. Nothing about your products or orders is transmitted externally. There is no backend, no outside API call, and no account involved.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Every matching product is now suggested, not just the first one found per issue type.
  • Suggestions are prioritized by each product’s sales history, so best selling products are proposed first.
  • Each suggestion type now varies its wording across a few phrasings instead of repeating one fixed sentence.
  • Up to ten new suggestions are added per run, and a suggestion already seen (in any status) is never repeated.

1.1.1

  • Renamed to “LS-WebStudio Product Optimizer for WooCommerce” (was “AddPlug CRO”).
  • Removed the Apply and Undo buttons on price anomaly suggestions, since this suggestion type never had a specific replacement value to apply in the first place.

1.1.0

  • Now completely free and independent of any external service. Conversion rate optimization analysis runs locally, with no external account or backend required.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: settings page, weekly scheduled analysis, suggestion dashboard with Apply, Dismiss, and Undo.
